Short title, extent, commencement and application

PLD 2021 Balochistan Statutes 239
PLD 2021 Balochistan Statutes 239
ACT XXII OF 2021
BALOCHISTAN BOARD OF TECHNICAL AND
VOCATIONAL EDUCATION ACT, 2021
An Act to provide for constitution and organization
of
an independent body to hold and conduct
examinations and
assessment of all technical and vocational
qualifications,
educations and trainings for occupational skills in
Balochistan
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
16th August, 2021]
No.
PAB/Legis:V(20)/2021, dated 16.8.2021.---The Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education Bill, 2021
(Bill No.20 of 2021), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 09th August, 2021 and assented to by the Governor Balochistan,
on 16th August, 2021 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan
Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to constitute and
organize an independent body i.e. the Balochistan Board of Technical and
Vocational Education, to hold and conduct examinations and assessment of all
technical and vocational qualifications, educations and trainings for
occupational skills in Balochistan; and for the matters ancillary therewith or
incidental thereto;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title, extent, commencement and application.---(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Board of Technical and
Vocational Education Act, 2021.
(2) It
extends to the whole of Balochistan.
(3) It
shall come into force on such date as Government may appoint by notification in
the official Gazette.
(4) It
shall apply to all establishments, public or private institute, polytechnic,
technical/vocational centers and all other skill and occupations that claims
for assessment, examination, recognition and award of certifications of all
disciplines within the purview of technical and vocational education and
trainings.

2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context: -
(a) "Act"
means the Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education Act, 2021;
(b) "Accreditation"
means affiliating the skills, technical and vocational institutions, and centers
on the prescribed conditions of the Board for recognition of its technical and
vocational qualifications;
(c) "Assessment
and Examination" means determining the eligible skills in accordance with
technical and vocational qualifications;
(d) "Assessor"
means an evaluator of skills at the discretion of Board to carry out the
assessment and examinations;
(e) "Board"
means the Balochistan Board of Technical and Vocational Education, as
established under section 3;
(f) "BTEVTA"
means the Balochistan Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority, as
constituted under the Balochistan Technical Education and Vocational Training
Authority Act, 2011 (Balochistan Act II of 2011);
(g) "Chairman"
means the Chairman of the Board;
(h) "Controlling
Authority" means the Controlling Authority of the Board as specified in
section 11 of the Act;
(i) "Committee"
means a committee constituted under section 18 of this Act;
(j) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(k) "Institute" means
technical institutions/colleges/schools, vocational training centers,
polytechnic and any other organization offering and producing skills and
occupations in the field of TVET;
(l) "Member"
means a member of the Board;
(m) "NAVTTC"
means National Vocational and Technical Training Commission, as constituted
under the National Vocational and Technical Training Commission Act 2011 (Act
XV of 2011);
(n) "NQF"
means National Qualification Framework of the Higher Education Commission of
Pakistan;
(o) "NVQF"
means National Vocational Qualification Framework as developed and maintained
by NAVTTC;
(p) "Occupation"
means someone working as semi-skilled, skilled, technician, professional and in
other related field of TVET;
(q) "Prescribed"
means prescribed by rules or regulations made under this Act;
(r) "Recognition"
means acceptance of skill, occupation, technical and vocational qualifications
on the prescribed conditions of the Board;
(s) "Regulations
or Rules" means respectively the regulation or rules made under this Act;
(t) "Skills"
means the tasks and duties performed by someone for a specific job conditions,
required for any workplace;
(u) "TVET"
means Technical and Vocational Education and Training, which as such encompass
the education and training for the cause of skills in formal, non-formal and/or
informal branches;

Qualification" means level and descriptors of skills and knowledge defined

of the Board.---(1) The Government

4. Constitution
of the Board.---(1) The Board
shall consist of the following members, namely:-
(a) Chairman;
(b) Director
General, Labour and Manpower Department;
(c) Director
General, Social Welfare Department;
(d) Director
General, Industries and Commerce Department;
(e) Director
General, Regional Office NAVTTC Quetta;
(f) Director
of Technical Education;
(g) Director
Manpower Training;
(h) Chairman,
Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Balochistan;
(i) a
Principal of Polytechnic Institute nominated by Controlling Authority;
(j) a
head of technical/vocational institute elected by and from among themselves;
(k) a
representative to be nominated from Higher Education Commission;
(l) a
representative from Inter Board Committee of Chairman, Quetta, to be nominated
by Controlling Authority;
(m) a
representative from Chamber of Commerce, Quetta to be nominated by Controlling
Authority; and
(n) an
Industrialist to be nominated by Controlling Authority;
(2) The
names of the nominated members shall be notified in the official Gazette.
(3) The
term of office of the members, other than the ex-officio members, shall
be three years.
(4) No
member appointed by virtue of his office shall continue to be a member if he
ceases to hold that office.
(5) When
a person ceases to be a member of the Board, he shall cease to be a member of
any committee constituted under any provision of the Act or rules made
thereunder.

(a) he
has become of unsound mind;

9. Functions
of the Board.---(1) Subject to the
provisions of this Act, the Board shall have power to organize, regulate,
develop and control the vocational qualifications and institutions through
assessment, examination, recognition and accreditation in the field of technical
and vocational education and training in Balochistan.
(2) In
particular and without prejudice to the generality of the power conferred
hereinabove subsection (1), the Board shall have the powers to-
(a) hold
and conduct examinations and assessments of technical and vocational
qualifications in accordance with the standards of NVQF and NQF;
(b) carry
out the functions of Qualification Awarding Body for skill recognitions;
(c) maintain
a pool of technical qualified assessors in the relevant course of vocational
qualifications that is practiced and delivered by any institution that falls
within the jurisdiction of the Board;
(d) describe
the means of assessment criteria for the levels of NVQF/NQF and awarding
certificates thereof;
(e) devise
and adopt competency based training and assessment for technical and vocational
qualifications in consultation with NAVTTC;
(f) ensure
the accreditation, recognition, assessment and affiliation of institute, center
and occupational skills on the criterion of national and international
practices and/or policies as may be prescribed by regulation;
(g) bring
encouraging improvements for alignment and adoption of distinct and
recognizable qualification frameworks;
(h) devise
monitoring and evaluation operational manuals for training providers in the
field of TVET;
(i) carry
out business matters of the Board by introducing technological and innovative
practices;
(j) inspect
and arrange for inspection of affiliated institutes and call for inspection
reports in respect to such institutions;
(k) fix,
demand and receive such fees as may be prescribed;
(l) supervise
the residence, health and discipline of the students of affiliated institutions
with a view to promote their general welfare;
(m) setup
and award scholarships, medals and prizes as may be prescribed by regulations;
(n) organize
and promote extracurricular activities for affiliated institutions, which shall
not be prejudice to religious, racial discrimination and provisions of this
Act;
(o) pass
its annual budget;
(p) hold
and manage endowments fund;
(q) make
provisions for buildings, premises, furniture, equipment, books and other means
required for carrying out the purposes of this Act;
(r) appoint
such staff, assessor and experts on conditional basis, as it may consider
necessary for the performance of its functions; provided that appointing

11. Powers
of Controlling Authority.---(1)
The Controlling Authority shall have the power to inspect itself or cause an
inspection to be made by such person or persons, as it may direct, of the
offices, activities and funds, and the conduct of examinations and assessments
by the Board, and to cause an enquiry to be made in respect of any matter
concerning the Board, or the discharge of functions by the members, officers
and staff of the Board.
(2) The
Controlling Authority may at any time suspend a member, an officer or staff of
the Board and order for inquiry of the matter to which he consider to be of
great negligence, inefficiency or misconduct.
(3) The
Controlling Authority may communicate to the Board the results of such
inspections or enquiry and may advise the Board to take such actions and within
such period as may be specified.
(4) The
Board shall report to the Controlling Authority the action taken on such
communication.
(5) Whereas
the Board does not, within a specified time, take action to the satisfaction of
the Controlling Authority, the Controlling Authority may, after considering any
explanation made by the Board, issue such directions as it thinks fit, and the
Chairman shall comply with such directions.
(6) If
the Controlling Authority is satisfied that any proceeding of the Board or a
Committee is not in conformity with the provisions of this Act, or regulations
or rules framed there under or in public interest, the Controlling Authority
may without prejudice to the foregoing provisions of this section, by order in
writing, annul such proceedings; provided that before making any such order,
the Controlling Authority shall, through the Chairman, call upon the Board or
the committee, as the case may be, to show cause why such an order should not
be made.
(7) The
Controlling Authority may, from time to time, direct the Board to conduct its
affairs and to perform its functions in such a manner as may be specified.
(8) The
Controlling Authority may require the Board to furnish it with:-
(a) any
return, statement, estimate, statistics or other information regarding any
matter under the control of the Board; or
(b) a
report on any such matter; or
(c) a
copy or original of any document in the charge of the Board, and the Chairman
shall comply with every such requisition and directions.

and Conditions for appointment of Chairman.---(1) The Chairman shall be a whole-time officer/Professor (B-20) of
Technical Education, appointed by the Controlling Authority on such terms and
conditions as prescribed.
(2) The
Chairman shall hold office for a term of two years from the date of his
appointment; and on expiry of his first term of office he may be reappointment
for a second term which shall in no case exceeding three years:

if satisfied that in the interest of the Board, or for any other sufficient
cause to be reduced in writing, it is necessary to do so, it may, after giving
the Chairman an opportunity of showing cause against the proposed action,
removed him from his office or reduce the term of his office to such period as
it may determine.
(3) Recruitment
of the chairman of the Board of technical and Vocational education shall be
through advertisement or with the approval of the Controlling Authority.
(4) If
at any time the office of the Chairman is vacant temporarily or otherwise, by
reason of leave, illness or other cause, for a period not exceeding four
months, the Controlling Authority shall take such arrangements for carrying out
the duties of the office of the Chairman, as it may think fit.

Committees of the Board constituted under section 17.

22. Punishment
and cognizance of offence.---(1)
Whoever contravenes any provision of this Act, or regulations or rules made
there under, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description which
may extend to one year or with fine which may extend to one hundred thousand
rupees or with both.
(2) If
the contravention of this Act or any rules or regulations made there under is
made by:--
(a) a
body corporate, every director, manager, secretary or other officers or agent
thereof; or
(b) other
body, organization or institution, every member or partner thereof, or the
manger or the principal officer running such body, organization or
institution,-
shall unless he proves that the contravention took
place without, his knowledge or that he exercised due diligence to prevent such
contravention, be deemed to be guilty of such contravention.
(3) No
Court shall take cognizance of an offence under this Act, except on a report in
writing of the facts constituting such offence made by the Chairman or any
officer or staff authorized by him in that behalf.
